review_notes: Read the whole file and the supporting lemmas in Geodesic.lean (geodesicLine_mul_pslS, geodesicLine_mul_dilation, and the range_ variants). The only real repetition is the reversed-line uniqueness argument, which appears in geodesicBetween_swap and again in the s > t branch of range_geodesicLine_geodesicBetween_of_mem. The fix needs no new lemma, because the existing range-swap lemma already covers it. I could not run Lean, so the rewritten proof is untested. I expect it to typecheck because the hypothesis `h : s > t` unfolds to `t < s`.

findings.excerpt: have : geodesicBetween (geodesicLine g s) (geodesicLine g t) = g * ↑(dilation s) * pslS := by
findings.problem: The s > t branch re-proves a reversed-line uniqueness argument by hand. It calls eq_geodesicBetween_of_geodesicLine_eq, then rewrites with geodesicLine_mul_pslS and geodesicLine_mul_dilation, then does an abs/linarith/ring computation. This is the same reasoning as geodesicBetween_swap (the `symm; refine eq_geodesicBetween_of_geodesicLine_eq …; rw [geodesicLine_mul_pslS, …geodesicLine_mul_dilation…]` pattern), and the file already proves range_geodesicLine_geodesicBetween_swap and the s < t case. The duplicated block also carries a non-trivial `congr 1; ring` step.
findings.proposed_change: Replace the whole `·` branch for `h : s > t` (i.e. `t < s`) by a reduction to the s < t case via the existing swap lemma: `· rw [← range_geodesicLine_geodesicBetween_swap (geodesicLine g t) (geodesicLine g s), geodesicBetween_geodesicLine_of_lt g h, range_geodesicLine_mul_dilation]`. The swap lemma has statement `range (between w z) = range (between z w)`, so with z := line g t and w := line g s the rewrite turns the goal into the (t < s) case. No new lemma is needed. The `have this … congr 1; ring` block disappears.
findings.benefit: This removes about ten lines of repeated machinery, including the fragile abs/linarith/ring arithmetic. The proof is now the one-line symmetry argument 'the image is symmetric in the endpoints, so assume s < t'. Any change to how reversal is parametrised then has to be fixed in only one place, geodesicBetween_swap.
